messages:
Olivia (CSM): Heads up — we just got the postmortem summary from eng. There was a degraded routing condition for embeddings ingestion between 03:12–03:45 PT that affected a subset of onboarding reindexes. Impacted customers: 6 onboarders in trial and 3 in paid POC. Need coordinated comms + credits + enablement plan.
Tara (CS Ops): Thanks. Which accounts are highest renewal risk? I can start drafting segmented notes.
Mike S. (Eng): Confirming: root cause was a config rollout that caused ~40% of streaming ingest requests to be routed to a stale worker pool with a bug in prefix handling. That led to partial failures and backoff spikes. We rolled back at 03:45 PT. Full queues drained by 04:10 PT.
Sam (SRE): Started additional requeue workers at 03:50 and manually re-enqueued affected jobs; reindex progress is at ~85% for those accounts as of 04:12. Still finishing batch 3.
Jess (Onboarding): Which customers specifically? Some of them are in week-1 enablement — we should call the ones with scheduled enablement sessions later today.
Olivia (CSM): List: AcmeRetail, PaperTrailAI, BeaconHealth, Currents, LumenDocs, BrightForms (trial); OmniLegal, StudyBox (paid POC), ApexSynth (paid POC). Prioritize AcmeRetail, OmniLegal, BeaconHealth.
Tara (CS Ops): Drafting two comms: (1) urgent status note for those currently mid-onboard, (2) RCA + compensation note for paid POCs. Posting first draft here for review.
Incident Bot: Incident INC-2026-111 created: embeddings-routing-partial-failures. Severity: P2.
Mike S. (Eng): Add: no customer data was exposed. No request payload loss — messages were retried, some timed out and required manual requeue. Root cause: rollout_flag=embed-routing-switch not gated. Fix: rollback + gating + add canary tests.
Olivia (CSM): Good. Draft 1 (status):

Olivia (CSM): "Hi <CustomerTeam>,

We wanted to let you know we experienced a short service disruption affecting the embeddings ingestion pipeline between 03:12–03:45 PT today. During that window, some onboarding import/reindex jobs were delayed or partially failed, and we’ve been working to reprocess them. Currently: all affected jobs have been re-queued and most are complete; we expect the remaining work to finish within 2 hours.

What we’re doing: we rolled back a config change, added temporary requeue workers, and are manually validating the final batch.

Impact to you: you may see delayed search/semantic results and slower training progress in onboarding; your onboarding session scheduled for today should still be possible — we’ll confirm in 30 min.

Next steps & remediation: we will follow up with a short RCA and a credit to cover the reprocessing/minor uptime impact if any production quotas were used. If you’d like, we can prioritize a one-on-one catch-up session to ensure your onboarding stays on track.

If you have questions or need immediate help, reply here or ping your CSM.

— Olivia (Customer Success)"

Tara (CS Ops): That reads well. For paid POCs add explicit SLA credit offer: "a one-time credit equivalent to 10% of last month’s bill or a fixed $X if less than billing history available" — legal ok with a standard phrase?
Mike S. (Eng): Engineering suggests we avoid percentage specifics in the first note; offer "a credit and closure in the RCA follow-up" and then CSMs can customize.
Jess (Onboarding): I'll call AcmeRetail and BeaconHealth now to confirm session time and reassure. Who does OmniLegal want to talk to — legal or CSM?
Olivia (CSM): OmniLegal asked for an expedite technical check last week; loop Mike in after I call.
Sam (SRE): ETA for remaining requeues: ~75 minutes. Post-queue validation script: run status check and return failed IDs. I'll drop the script output when done.
Tara (CS Ops): Draft 2 (RCA + credit):

Tara (CS Ops): "Hi <CustomerTeam>,

RCA: Between 03:12–03:45 PT a configuration rollout inadvertently routed a portion of embeddings ingestion traffic to an outdated worker pool. That pool had a bug causing intermittent timeouts and failed requeue handling. We detected the issue via error-rate alerts, rolled back the change, and started manual requeues. No customer data was exposed.

Mitigation & follow-up: we have patched the rollout gating, added an automated pre-rollout canary that simulates ingest patterns, and increased our alerting for requeue lag. We will publish the full engineering postmortem within 48 hours.

Compensation: We will issue a one-time account credit for demonstrable reprocessing or quota overage; your CSM will follow up with a tailored offer.

If you have any questions or require immediate remediation, please let us know.

— Tara (Customer Success Ops)"

Olivia (CSM): Approve. Mike, can you confirm the 48-hour postmortem timeline?
Mike S. (Eng): Yes. We’ll have a public postmortem draft in 48 hours and a final internal RCA with timeline/patch notes in 72.
Jess (Onboarding): Outreach plan: I’ll call AcmeRetail (now), BeaconHealth (in 20m), LumenDocs (ASAP). Olivia — can you handle OmniLegal + ApexSynth?
Olivia (CSM): Yes I’ll handle OmniLegal and ApexSynth, and will offer a 1:1 troubleshooting session and a spot in our next onboarding office hours.
Tara (CS Ops): I'm going to prepare the outbound email list and include ticket IDs for requeues. Also tagging billing to prepare provisional credits for OmniLegal and ApexSynth.
Sam (SRE): Posting validation summary now: 1978002460 - requeue completed for 9/9 jobs, 2 minor timeouts retried successfully. All good.
Olivia (CSM): Great. For renewal-risk accounts (OmniLegal, BeaconHealth) let's schedule a proactive exec sync if they ask. Also capture feedback: was documentation/UX part of the blocker? Jess, ask customers if they hit any unclear errors during upload.
Jess (Onboarding): Will capture notes in the onboarding tracker and add a "post-incident check" item to each affected onboarding ticket.
Tara (CS Ops): Final checklist for outbound: 1) send status note now to all 9 customers, 2) follow with RCA draft to paid POCs within 24h, 3) CSMs to offer credits and 1:1 sessions, 4) onboarding to confirm schedules. Assigning owners in a moment.
Olivia (CSM): Owners: Olivia -> OmniLegal, ApexSynth; Jess -> AcmeRetail, BeaconHealth, LumenDocs; Tara -> outbound messages + billing; Mike -> engineering postmortem; Sam -> final validation; Incident Bot -> update incident page when postmortem is published.
Sam (SRE): All validation checks green; will update incident status to "mitigated" once we finish the 1-hour post-requeue monitoring window.
Olivia (CSM): Thanks team — please log any customer escalations here. I'll start sending the status note and post the sent copy in thread.
Tara (CS Ops): Sent status message to all nine with ticket refs. Pinging for reactions. :email::white_check_mark:
Olivia (CSM): Thanks, adding follow-up reminders to my calendar for 24h and 48h.
Jess (Onboarding): Oncall note: if any customer needs an immediate engine-side rollback or targeted data recovery, escalate to #eng-runtime and tag me.
Olivia (CSM): Closing loop: will report back after the 48h postmortem is ready and after credits are applied.
